representation_plans.learner_operation: Locate electron production and consumption before assigning cell-type polarity.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State each supplied half-reaction, the electrode where it occurs, the external electron direction, the cell type, and the corresponding signs without revealing an item response.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Select cathodic reduction, subtract the alternative listed reduction potential, and verify direction.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Read each reduction half-reaction and potential in a linear list, then state cathode-minus-anode setup without supplying a scored result.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Convert current and time to charge, then use electron stoichiometry to determine product amount.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List the unit sequence from amperes and seconds through coulombs and electron moles to product moles, with the supplied half-reaction coefficient.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Place ion creation and ion consumption where they reduce the concentration difference.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State the common metal, each ion concentration, the oxidation and reduction locations, and the electron direction in ordered prose.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Separate per-cell redox chemistry from series-voltage aggregation and recharge direction.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List cell count, voltage per cell, connection type, named discharge oxidation and reduction, and whether an external charger is present.
